entities.summary: Igor Vladimirovich Rybakov is a Russian businessman and co-founder of Technonicol, a manufacturer of construction materials. In September 2025, Rybakov held 1,513th position on the Forbes Real-Time Billionaires list, with an estimated net worth of $2.4 billion.
